output.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue = true AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: Revenue is taken from marts.fct_orders, limited to orders flagged is_revenue = true (the warehouse's definition of revenue-counting orders), summing net_revenue for order_date in calendar year 2025 (2025-01-01 inclusive to 2026-01-01 exclusive). The result is rounded to 2 decimals. No personal or confidential columns are used.
